text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Speaker of Iraq's National Assembly urges world parliamentarians to press Turkey to change its stand on U.S.-led airforce patrolling northern Iraq.
- Ankara announces an Iraqi-Turkish gas pipeline will be set up shortly.
- Jordanian energy minister arrives in Baghdad.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- National Assembly appreciates Iran's move to free 722 Iraqi prisoners of war, but urges Iran to free all Iraqi POWs.
